note.windows: The build takes about 30 minutes and 1 GB (the catalog of PLUSLITE.EXE is the slow step). Python and the Visual Studio Build Tools are installed if they are missing; the Build Tools are about 3 GB and add 15 to 30 minutes, and Windows asks for permission once. Point it at your Rp_lite.exe installer (it is unpacked, never run) or a folder holding PLUSLITE.EXE.
